title: Tribulus terrestris tea for medicinal use
intro: Tribulus terrestris tea is a herbal preparation made from the dried fruits of the Tribulus terrestris plant, commonly known as puncture vine. This tea is traditionally used in herbalism to support vitality, enhance libido, and promote overall wellness. It is often consumed as a tonic to improve energy levels and may be used to address issues related to stress and fatigue. In some cultures, it is also believed to have benefits for reproductive health and athletic performance. The preparation is typically brewed by steeping the dried fruits in hot water for several minutes.
